J  I.A.No.1 of 2025  Dispensed with for the present.

The learned counsel for the petitioner  submits that the petitioner is arraigned as accused  in C.C.No.2930 of 2024 on the file of Judicial  Magistrate of First Class (Special Mobile Court),
 Nellore, for alleged offences under Sections 498A  of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition  Act.

 Nellore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner  submits that even as per the charge sheet, there  are no specific allegations against the petitioner in  the commission of alleged offence.

Considering the same, there shall be stay of  appearance of the petitioner in C.C.No.2930 of  2024 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First  Class (Special Mobile Court), Nellore, except on  the dates when the presence of the petitioner is  required for the purpose of trial.
